mood.label: CAUTIOUSLY-RISK-ON
mood.summary: Massive earnings beats from Nvidia and key software players are igniting a strong risk-on rally within the tech sector, but leadership is narrow. The play is to focus on the clear momentum in AI and software while the rest of the market digests macro uncertainty ahead of Jackson Hole.

indicesNarrative: US futures are pointing to a gap-up open, driven by a powerful rally in the tech sector after Nvidia's stellar earnings report and bullish guidance. The Nasdaq is set to dramatically outperform the Dow, highlighting a narrow, theme-driven market leadership centered on AI.
